javaOnlyFiles.ControllerSupport: Desktop JInput controller discovery is replaced by the browser input layer.
javaOnlyFiles.JackalAppGameContainer: Desktop Slick2D container behavior is replaced by the PWA shell and AppGameContainer integration.
javaOnlyFiles.LoadingMode: Browser resource preparation and loading UI are owned by the PWA shell.

typescriptOnlyFiles.AudioRegistry: Browser save-state persistence assigns stable IDs to Jackal Sound objects without changing Java gameplay semantics.
typescriptOnlyFiles.MainRuntimeState: Breaks ESM circular dependencies while preserving Java-style global runtime ownership.
typescriptOnlyFiles.GameTileTypes: Cycle-safe source of truth for tile type constants shared by GameMode and translated entities.
typescriptOnlyFiles.PlayerMotionConstants: Cycle-safe source of truth for Player motion constants and precomputed rumble values used by cutscenes.
typescriptOnlyFiles.JackalMath: Provides a cycle-safe, Java-float-compatible rotation helper shared by Main and Player.
typescriptOnlyFiles.JackalResources: Provides the browser resource-loading boundary for Jackal packed data files.

Main.showMouseCursor.reason: Java desktop cursor restoration is part of its legacy fullscreen lifecycle; browser presentation is owned by the PWA shell.

Main.hideMouseCursor.reason: Java desktop cursor hiding is part of its legacy fullscreen lifecycle; browser presentation is owned by the PWA shell.

HumanInput.isFullscreenTogglePressed.reason: Java retains legacy Space desktop fullscreen input; the browser PWA shell owns fullscreen and leaves Space available as a remappable gameplay key.

HumanInput.isEscape.reason: Java retains legacy Escape desktop fullscreen input; the browser PWA shell owns Escape as the return-to-menu command.

IInput.isFullscreenTogglePressed.reason: The Java input interface exposes its legacy desktop fullscreen toggle; browser fullscreen is owned by the PWA shell instead.

IInput.isEscape.reason: The Java input interface exposes its legacy Escape fullscreen control; browser Escape is reserved by the PWA shell for returning to the menu.

enumMemberExceptions.Modes.LOADING: Browser loading is owned by JackalWebApp rather than a gameplay mode.

behaviorExceptions.ButtonMapping.browserFullscreenKeys: Java reserves Space and Escape for its desktop fullscreen controls. The PWA reserves only Escape for its browser menu, leaving Space as a normal remappable gameplay key.
behaviorExceptions.IntroMode.browserFullscreenInstruction: Java displays its Space fullscreen instruction on the title screen. The PWA deliberately omits that line because fullscreen belongs to the browser menu.
behaviorExceptions.Main.update.fadeTiming: The browser advances the 23-level screen fade from Jackal's existing 10 ms fixed-update loop. This intentionally removes the Java desktop version's display-refresh dependency while leaving the Java source unchanged.
behaviorExceptions.Main.browserFullscreenOwnership: Java keeps its Space/Escape Slick fullscreen lifecycle. The PWA shell owns browser fullscreen entry, exit, fallback, and menu transitions instead.
